abort.wrong_account: The account you logged in with differs from the one configured for this entry. Add the other account as a new Frank Energie integration instead.
abort.no_sites: No active delivery address was found for this account.

init.title: Frank Energie options
init.description: Choose the notation used for the 'from'/'till' times in the price sensors' attributes and the get_prices action, and configure the electricity price analysis (cheap/expensive thresholds, the cheapest period length and, optionally, a solar production forecast).

data_description.prices_timezone: Only changes how the 'from'/'till' times are displayed, not the actual moments they represent. If you have automations (e.g. in Node-RED) that parse this text, you may need to update them after changing this setting.
data_description.cheap_price_threshold: All-in electricity prices at or below this are considered cheap.
data_description.expensive_price_threshold: All-in electricity prices above this are considered expensive.
data_description.cheapest_period_minutes: The length of the contiguous period with the lowest average price that the price analysis looks for.
data_description.solar_forecast_entry: An optional integration that forecasts solar production, used to mark cheap slots with enough forecast solar production as 'cheap + solar'.
data_description.solar_threshold_kwh: The forecast solar production (kWh per hour) from which a cheap slot is marked as 'cheap + solar'.

error.thresholds_invalid: The cheap price threshold must be lower than the expensive price threshold.

get_prices.name: Get prices
get_prices.description: Returns the cached electricity and gas prices for a Frank Energie config entry, without contacting the Frank Energie API.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Frank Energie config entry to get prices for.

start.name: Start time
start.description: Only return price slots ending after this time. Defaults to including all available slots.

end.name: End time
end.description: Only return price slots starting before this time. Defaults to including all available slots.

entry_not_found.message: Frank Energie config entry "{entry_id}" not found.

entry_not_loaded.message: Frank Energie config entry "{entry_id}" is not loaded.

invalid_period.message: The start time must be before the end time.
